To

The Addl. Central PF Commissioner (Zones),
All RPFCs-I & II, Regional Offices

Sub:-Instructions regarding conduct of quasi-judicial proceedings in field offices.
Sir,

It has come to notice that there has been an instance of unnecessarily making a separate
7A proceedings room in a field office. It is informed that no such exclusive/separate room is

allowed as per existing instructions.

2 In this regard, it is stated that
a) 7A & 14B proceedings can be conducted without mixing up routine/office work and should
be held in officers own cubicle/chamber as it is not an exclusive work but part of the work
entrusted to an officer. This will also be economically prudent in terms of space and time.
b) It is also advised to fix the 7A/14B enquires by each officer depending upon his/her

workload on any one or two days in a week in forenoon or afternoon sessions.
3. This is for your information and necessary compliance.

[This issues with the approval of CPFC]

Yours faithfully,

Da Cecrple,

(S.C. Goyal)
Addl. Central PF Commissioner (Compliance)
